author: FobaGOD
body:
I'm banned by Combat Log (4th offense)

Edans sent me the evidence: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ERSajQSpDDA
The name of the person who fell isn't seen and I could have been spectating
That was my conversation with Edans in TS:

<22:11:13> You poked "Seth [Edans][Laptop]" with message: Not enough evidence
<22:11:54> "Seth [Edans][Laptop]" pokes you: sure
<22:12:30> You poked "Seth [Edans][Laptop]" with message: When the player fell, you can't see his IGN
<22:14:06> "Seth [Edans][Laptop]" pokes you: You can clearly see me tp to you. Plus when i tp to you, You're in the void as a spectator.
<22:14:47> You poked "Seth [Edans][Laptop]" with message: Because I can spec too
<22:16:24> You poked "Seth [Edans][Laptop]" with message: in the video the name isn't seen
<22:16:49> "Seth [Edans][Laptop]" pokes you: In the video, you see me tp to you and follow you right before you try to bridge and fall to combat
<22:16:53> "Seth [Edans][Laptop]" pokes you: log
<22:17:06> "Seth [Edans][Laptop]" pokes you: If you have any other complaints, make an appeal on the forums
<22:17:46> You poked "Seth [Edans][Laptop]" with message: the name of the person falling isn't seen

title: My Appeal

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello Foba,

In the video, the character in the void is clearly you, easily recognizable by your skin, in addition to the fact that when Seth teleported to you, you happened to be in the void and a spectator. You fell, and almost two seconds later (which is not enough time to be killed by the void), you were seen as a spectator, and there was no chat message indicating your death. In addition, you were almost instantly seen back at spawn, which again, doesn't go by Minecraft timeframes. Unfortunately, this evidence is easily acceptable. By the punishment guidelines, and your infractions separate from combat logging, a permanent ban is necessary. Feel free to appeal in a few months.

Regards,
Qinn | Administrator
